title: Turkey Jandarma Recruitment 2026: Requirements & Careers
metaDescription: Turkey Jandarma recruitment 2026: citizenship, age and education rules, KPSS scores, physical standards, academy training, and career paths explained in full.
headline: Joining the Turkish Jandarma: 2026 Recruitment Guide

sections.title: What the Jandarma Does
sections.content:
The Turkish Gendarmerie, or Jandarma Genel Komutanlığı, is a paramilitary force responsible for security in rural areas, border regions, and places outside municipal police jurisdiction. Its duties include counter-terrorism, border protection, traffic control on rural roads, and support to civilian authorities during emergencies.

The force operates under the Ministry of Interior in peacetime and has a military structure, with officers, non-commissioned officers, and specialist soldiers serving across Turkey's 81 provinces. Women now serve in growing numbers, including in commando and specialist roles, following dedicated recruitment drives.

sections.title: Who Can Apply?
sections.content:
Applicants must be citizens of the Republic of Turkey, with a clean criminal record and no condition that would prevent armed service. Education requirements vary by track: officer candidates generally need a university degree, while specialist soldier and non-commissioned officer routes accept high school or associate degree graduates, depending on the announcement.

Age limits also vary by track. Recent specialist soldier announcements have set the age range at 20 to 27, while other tracks set their own limits in each announcement. Candidates must also pass security and archive investigations, and membership of a political party disqualifies applicants for some uniformed tracks.

sections.title: Exams, Fitness and Selection
sections.content:
Most tracks require a score in the Public Personnel Selection Exam (KPSS); a recent specialist soldier announcement required at least 50 points. Candidates then face physical fitness tests, medical examinations, and interviews. Height, fitness, and medical standards are applied strictly, since gendarmes serve in demanding field conditions.

Applications are made online through the Jandarma's citizen portal and the Jandarma and Coast Guard Academy website, within the dates stated in each announcement. Announcements appear in the Official Gazette and on the academy's site, so candidates should check these sources rather than relying on social media posts.

sections.title: Training and Career
sections.content:
Successful candidates train at the Jandarma and Coast Guard Academy (JSGA) in Ankara and at specialist training centres. Officer training combines academic study with military and leadership instruction, while specialist soldiers complete intensive basic and branch training before posting to units.

Career paths include rural patrol, commando units, traffic, criminal investigation, and aviation and maritime support roles. Promotion follows service, performance, and further training, and experienced gendarmes can move into instructional, staff, and specialist command positions over a long career.

faqs.q: What are the age limits for Jandarma recruitment?
faqs.a: Age limits depend on the track and are stated in each announcement. Recent specialist soldier announcements set the range at 20 to 27 years, measured from 1 January of the announcement year. Officer and non-commissioned officer tracks set different limits, so candidates must always check the current announcement for their chosen track before applying.

faqs.q: Do I need a KPSS score to join the Jandarma?
faqs.a: Most tracks require a KPSS score, and the minimum varies by announcement. A recent specialist soldier announcement required at least 50 points in the relevant KPSS category. Officer candidates may face different exam requirements, including university entrance and academy selection exams, depending on the route they choose.

faqs.q: Where do I apply for Jandarma recruitment?
faqs.a: Applications are submitted online through the Jandarma citizen portal and the Jandarma and Coast Guard Academy website during the dates given in the announcement. Announcements are published in the Official Gazette and on the academy's official site. Candidates should never pay intermediaries who promise guaranteed selection, as recruitment is merit-based.

faqs.q: Can women join the Turkish Jandarma?
faqs.a: Yes, women serve in the Jandarma in growing numbers, including as officers, non-commissioned officers, and specialist soldiers. Dedicated recruitment drives have expanded female intake, including female commando training on the same standards as men. Height and fitness requirements for women are stated separately in each announcement.
